info.name: PyTorch image classifier (ExecuTorch + QNN)
info.description: Fine-tunes an ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV2 on Edge Impulse image data and exports an ONNX model for the platform, plus an ExecuTorch .pte program for native PyTorch on-device inference. A compact from-scratch CNN is available for size-constrained targets. Optionally also lowers a quantized model_qnn.pte for the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU (QNN/HTP).

parameters.name: Number of training epochs
parameters.help: Number of passes over the training set.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: Learning rate for the Adam optimizer. 0.0001 suits fine-tuning the pretrained backbone; raise to around 0.001 if you enable 'Train from scratch'.

parameters.name: Batch size
parameters.help: Number of samples per gradient update.

parameters.name: Train from scratch
parameters.help: Train the small from-scratch CNN instead of fine-tuning MobileNetV2. Much smaller and faster, but needs far more data to reach comparable accuracy. Raise the learning rate to around 0.001 if you enable this.

parameters.name: Freeze backbone
parameters.help: Train only the classifier head and leave the pretrained feature extractor unchanged. Faster to train and sometimes better on very small datasets. Ignored when training from scratch.

parameters.name: Disable data augmentation
parameters.help: Turn off training-time horizontal flips, affine jitter and colour jitter. Augmentation usually helps on small datasets, so leave this off unless your data already covers the variation you expect.

parameters.name: Export ExecuTorch .pte
parameters.help: Also export an ExecuTorch program (model.pte) alongside the ONNX model. The .pte is not used by the Edge Impulse SDK but is handy for native PyTorch/ExecuTorch deployment.

parameters.name: Export QNN .pte (Qualcomm NPU)
parameters.help: Also export model_qnn.pte, int8-quantized and lowered to the Qualcomm QNN backend for the Hexagon NPU (e.g. IQ-9075). Needs the QNN SDK baked into the image. A failure is logged and never fails training; see export_report.json.

parameters.name: QNN SoC model
parameters.help: ExecuTorch QcomChipset name to compile for. IQ-9075 EVK uses the QCS9100 (Hexagon v73) target.

parameters.name: QNN quantization
parameters.help: Activation/weight bit widths. 8a8w is the default and the fastest; 16a8w trades speed for accuracy.

parameters.name: QNN calibration samples
parameters.help: Training images used to calibrate int8 ranges.
